source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: During the active player's Movement phase, every one of that player's units carried inside a TRANSPORT model may get out through a **[Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/disembark-move)** (18.04). When a TRANSPORT model is **destroyed**, then, for every unit inside it, the active player has to resolve the **[Emergency Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/emergency-disembark-move)** (18.05), and do so before the TRANSPORT is taken off the battlefield.

voluntary.units: the active player's units embarked within a Transport model

forced.timing: before the Transport model is removed from the battlefield

referenceAdditions.topic: the two cross-references read as rule codes (18.04, 18.05) where print points the reader elsewhere on the spread
